title: Reproducibility checklist (template)
summary: The checks every experiment note gets.
body:
Before a result is written up:

- [ ] Seed recorded for every run
- [ ] Config saved next to the output
- [ ] Library versions recorded
- [ ] Dataset version or hash recorded
- [ ] Best run and last run both reported
- [ ] Failed runs listed, not dropped

A failed run with a recorded seed is worth more than a lucky run without one.

lines: The checklist I use is in the Vault.
